verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI presents itself as an open-source library with "no forced API keys, no paywalls". The evidence pack never documents any billing quota or how failed, blocked, or empty-result requests are metered. Billing transparency is a fair question for web-crawling tools, so the axis applies, but there is no first-party evidence on this specific behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether failed, blocked, or empty-result requests still consume my billing quota
